# ToolCall

data class [ToolCall](index.html)(val id: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val toolType: [ToolType](../-tool-type/index.html)? = null, val args: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>? = null)

A tool call the model runs on its own server side.

The client does not execute this call; it echoes the part back on the next request together with the matching [ToolResponse](../-tool-response/index.html), or the model redoes the work it already did.
